english.title: Use a defective drivers card in a vehicle
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used a defective driver card in contravention of Article 14(4)(a) of the Community Recording Equipment Regulation in a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to which section 97 of the Transport Act 1968 applied
english.legislation: Contrary to section 97(1)(a) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) Where the place of offence is uncertain, see section 103(7) of the Act, which provides that an offence may be treated as having been committed at the place of driving, the person's place of residence or the principal place of business.
(ii) Section 97(7) defines the "Community Recording Equipment Regulation" as Council Regulation (EEC ) No. 561/06, as amended.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Fixed penalty ticket - One hundred pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
